requires.purpose: the identifiers records are keyed by, its lifecycle events, and the disclosure-context port, adapted by the host; there is no package dependency
the signed-in principal for each /api/profile request, through the host's subject resolver; there is no package dependency
whether a viewer may see a group's suspended members by name, through the host's access-decision port; there is no package dependency

integration.consumers: domain capabilities store identifiers only and ask Profile for display names; they never read the profile schema
integration.composition: host supplies ports from a Nitro plugin; persistence follows ADR-0002 and ADR-0006; identities and memberships belong to Identity
